item.title: ONE OR EIGHT's 'POWER' featured as 'Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers (Ronin Warriors)' ending theme — listen
item.description: ONE OR EIGHT is back with their electrifying single 'POWER' that definitely lives up to its name. The track is one of several on the tracklist of their debut mini album GATHER. 'POWER' also gave ONE OR EIGHT the opportunity for their first-ever anime tie-up, as it was featured as the closing theme for the acclaimed TV anime Yoroi-Shinden Samurai Troopers (Ronin Warriors). 'POWER' brings the charisma and soaring richness of ONE OR EIGHT's vocals and exudes their dynamic and versatile music style

item.title: HYBE & ENHYPEN's 'DARK MOON: THE BLOOD ALTAR' animated series launches globally on Crunchyroll
item.description: HYBE’s original story animation DARK MOON: THE BLOOD ALTAR is making its global debut on 9 January, bringing its vampire fantasy universe to over 80 regions worldwide. Based on the hit webtoon of the same name — a project in collaboration with ENHYPEN that has amassed over 200 million views — the series marks a major move in HYBE’s expanding transmedia universe. Fans can now immerse themselves in a new dimension of the DARK MOON saga through the animated series, which will stream on Crunchyroll

item.title: BLACKPINK's LISA set to present at the 83rd Golden Globe Awards
item.description: LISA of BLACKPINK is set to make a major Hollywood appearance as a presenter at the 83rd Golden Globe Awards, happening this Sunday, 11 January in Los Angeles. The announcement places LISA among a prestigious lineup of global stars presenting at one of the film and television industry’s most high-profile nights. While the Golden Globes have increasingly embraced international talent, LISA’s inclusion marks a standout moment for K-pop representation on the awards stage. View this post on Instagra

item.description: We Are Imaginary return with their self-titled third album that takes listeners on a journey of reckoning and emotional release.
